decisions.reason: For F(z)=z²/2 and U=x/t on (0,1)×(1,2), U_t+(F(U))_x=0. Write a smooth test as b(x)+t a(x)+O(t²). Even if the old filter requires only the combined integrand to be integrable, its t^(-2) coefficient is x² b_prime/2, forcing b_prime=0 and hence b=0 by compact spatial support. Its t^(-1) coefficient is x a+x² a_prime/2, forcing (x²a)_prime=0 and hence a=0. Thus admitted tests are O(t²), and integration by parts gives zero bulk integral because U(epsilon)phi(epsilon)=O(epsilon). The initial term vanishes for every U0. Repaired by requiring state and flux integrability on every (0,tau)×K and the identity for every initial-boundary test. The singular field now fails the solution-class condition.
